source_documents: PCDA O Pune All Frequently Asked Questons Dec 2025.pdf (pp. 15-20)

gallantry_awards.tax_exemption: 100% exempted from Income Tax under AO 46/79
gallantry_awards.bar_rule: Each bar to the decoration carries the same amount of monetary allowance as admissible to original award.
gallantry_awards.survivorship_rules: On recipient's death, allowance continues to widow lawfully married until her death. If bachelor, paid to father/mother.

flying_allowance.eligible_personnel: Officers of Army Aviation Corps and qualified pilots
flying_allowance.escalation_trigger: Increases by 25% each time DA rises by 50%

special_forces_allowance.escalation_trigger: Increases by 25% each time DA rises by 50%
special_forces_allowance.authority: MoD letter No. B/36389/AG/PS3(b)/82/S/D(Pay/Services) dated 18 Sept 2017

qualification_allowance_aviation.escalation_trigger: Increases by 25% each time DA rises by 50%

technical_allowance.description: Technically qualified officers in accordance with SAI 5/S/76

ration_money_allowance.description: RMA in lieu of free rations in peace or field concessional areas
ration_money_allowance.own_arrangements: Admissible in exceptional circumstances with prior approval of Local Station Commander

house_rent_allowance.definition_of_basic_pay: Pay drawn in prescribed Level in Pay Matrix only; excludes NPA, MSP, and special pay.

selected_place_of_residence.rule: Admissible at SPR or Home Town rate when posted to concessional/field/afloat areas
selected_place_of_residence.license_fee: Charged at married accommodation rate for reserved accommodation occupied at duty station

house_rent_allowance.nac_dispensation: Dispensation of condition of furnishing No Accommodation Certificate (NAC) for admissibility of HRA

children_education_allowance.children_exception: Two eldest surviving children; exception if second childbirth results in twins/multiples
mandatory_evidence: School Bonafide Certificate / Self-Declaration for CEA
Hostel fee receipt showing lodging and boarding for Hostel Subsidy
